name: mokta-ai-3d
description: mokta ai 3D Online AI — محرك إعادة بناء ثلاثي الأبعاد محلي ومستقل بالذكاء الاصطناعي

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');http.createServer((req,res)=>{let f=req.url.split('?')[0];if(f==='/')f='/index.html';let p=path.join(process.cwd(),f);if(!fs.existsSync(p)||fs.statSync(p).isDirectory()){res.writeHead(404);res.end('404 Not Found');return;}let m={'html':'text/html;charset=utf-8','js':'application/javascript;charset=utf-8','css':'text/css;charset=utf-8','json':'application/json','png':'image/png','jpg':'image/jpeg','svg':'image/svg+xml','glb':'model/gltf-binary','txt':'text/plain;charset=utf-8','xml':'application/xml;charset=utf-8','webmanifest':'application/manifest+json;charset=utf-8','ico':'image/x-icon','webp':'image/webp'}[p.split('.').pop()]||'application/octet-stream';res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m,'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':'*'});fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res);}).listen(process.env.PORT||3000,'0.0.0.0',()=>console.log('Mokta AI 3D server running on port '+(process.env.PORT||3000)));"
